verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a Data Access API, published as an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, that exposes errors, projects and organization data. A probe also confirms an official SmartBear MCP server, with OAuth 2.0 support for the self-hosted MCP server, so an agent can pull production errors. BugSnag separately offers triage (status actions, automatic assignment rules) and Jira/issue-tracker creation and sync, but the evidence never shows these exposed as agent-callable API or MCP tools. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the API/MCP returns full stack traces and ranks top issues, documented API/MCP tools for triage actions and for filing tracker issues, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent workflow.
